What this changes and why:

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] I ran the page with `npm run dev` and tried the change in a browser
- [ ] If a template, `public/` or `kit.config.json` changed, I ran `npm run demo:build` and committed `docs/`
- [ ] Nothing new loads from another site, sets a new cookie or stores a new kind of data, or the privacy notice says so
